whatsappMessage:
Hi Monica's Team,

I noticed your salon has exceptional 4.9★ reviews from over 700 clients in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new appointment inquiries.

Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp appointment booking, bridal/styling service menu, aur client gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/monicas

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Monica's Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Monica's) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp booking and a showcase of your top-rated styling and bridal services in Kankarbagh, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
